text: Can you pull together every ticket number on Quarrendon Freight Lines you can find across Moss's notes? List each with where it comes from. Putting it in the weekly notes.
reply_text:

- **#4419** comes from "Moss: North cheat sheet" (North digests). Barcode scanners at Door 14 weren't reading trailer tags on third shift. The note says it was escalated to tier-2 support. The cheat sheet has no date, so I told Dana its status may be out of date.

I also told her that two other Moss notes mention Quarrendon but give no ticket numbers. The tickets in Moss's Central notes belong to other accounts.

I only used Moss's notes from the shared team digests, which Dana can open herself. I left out any tickets that show up only in other people's notes or emails, because she asked for Moss's notes only.
